newsitem.title: CANADA: William Resources subsidiary to amalgamate.
newsitem.headline: William Resources subsidiary to amalgamate.

text.p: Rux Resources Inc, a subsidiary of William Resources Inc, and Lago Resources Ltd said on Wednesday they agreed to amalgamate.
The reverse takeover would give Rux shareholders 90 percent of the new company and Lago shareholders would own 10 percent.
The new company would be named Rux Resources Inc and have about C$3.1 million in cash on hand, they said.
Lago is an Ontario company traded on the over-the-counter Canadian Dealing Network, with mining claims in Nevada.
The new company will hold mining interests in the Russian far east and Uzbekistan.
William Resources will own about 56 percent of the issued shares of the new company, Rux and Lago said. They said William has said it would vote for the amalgamation.
The transactions were expected to be completed before the end of the year.
